# PR Review — #1842

## Summary
Adds exponential backoff to the upload queue. Touches 4 files, no schema changes.

## Findings
- src/queue/retry.ts:42 — the backoff multiplier is applied before the cap, so delays can exceed the 30s ceiling.
- src/queue/uploader.ts:118 — the retry counter resets on re-enqueue, so retries can run unbounded.
- test/queue/retry.test.ts:9 — no test covers the capped path.

## Risk
Medium: uploads only, and only when the remote returns 5xx.

## Recommendation
Merge after capping the multiplier and adding a test for the capped path.

# PR Review — #1842

## Summary
Retry hardening for the upload queue: bounded backoff plus a counter reset fix.

## Findings
- src/queue/retry.ts:42 — cap is checked before the multiplier, so a 5xx storm can stack beyond 30s.
- src/queue/uploader.ts:118 — counter reset makes the retry budget per-enqueue instead of per-upload.

## Risk
Low: no API surface change. Worst case is slower retries on flaky networks.

## Recommendation
Ship the cap fix in this PR; the counter reset can follow separately.

# PR Review — #1842

## Summary
Four files changed around upload retries. One correctness issue, one budget issue.

## Findings
- src/queue/retry.ts:42 — multiplier runs before the ceiling check.
- src/queue/uploader.ts:118 — retry budget resets on every enqueue.
- src/queue/metrics.ts:27 — exhausted retries emit no metric, so failures are invisible.
- test/queue/retry.test.ts:9 — the capped path has no test.

## Risk
Medium: silent exhaustion is the risk, not data loss.

## Recommendation
Cap first, then emit a metric when the budget is exhausted.
